changesSinceRecordedExecution.reason: Root changed DraftField sync dependency from reference identity to serialized semantic value and announces discard on actual semantic-value replacement. No public test/helper/API dependency changed.

checks.observation: The arrange handler invokes apply(arrangeDraft) once, then fits the returned draft snapshot. apply performs one changeDraft history transition; fit changes camera only and also includes route points.

Display text is not used as identity. A diagnostic must identify exactly one existing node, and its kind must be registered. Parameter and port targets are retained only if listed in that module contract.
reportError resolves against current draft/catalog, focuses that exact node and exposes node badge, registered field/port highlight, localized message, optional technical details and a locate button.
Committed edits and undo/redo clear backend feedback; draft and history remain separate from camera.

Independent metadata test rejects empty tokens, nonfinite/out-of-range/noninteger values and invalid fixed/minimum/maximum array length. Corrected final numeric values are returned. This is metadata helper coverage, not a run across all actual catalog module kinds.
Raw change sets validity immediately. Header and save/generate function guards block requests while invalidFieldsRef is nonempty; raw invalid input is shown using aria-invalid and field alert.

The field sync effect depends on JSON-serialized semantic value instead of object identity. An unchanged array copied by node movement/name editing does not reset raw text/invalid state. A real semantic-value replacement explicitly announces discarding an invalid uncommitted input.

Escape restoration and field unmount announce discard when raw invalid input was present, then restore/retain the last committed valid parameter. UI confirmation remains assigned to root browser regression.

save, reopen and generate capture the current draft object. Both success and error state changes require the same snapshot identity still be current. Reopen replacement is inside that guard; it fits the returned reopened draft.

Catalog and catalogRef are installed before asynchronous initial validation. An initial validation error can apply only while mounted and while the initial draft object remains current; it cannot focus a newer edited draft.

apply and model gesture/keyboard entry points refuse editing when busy; header/inspector mutation buttons and numeric fields are disabled. Camera/search exploration remains view state. This is read-only code evidence, not a browser race test.

The empty search result explains supported search examples and unavailable Attention/LSTM/composite presets, and offers clear-search. Palette module counts come from actual catalog rather than a hard-coded support count.

resolvedSourceFindings.resolution: ApiError uses explicit fields and constructor assignments; earlier failed logs are preserved.
Fit button calls a zero-argument wrapper instead of passing a MouseEvent to the optional draft argument.
restore() checks invalidRef and invokes the discard notice before resetting raw text.
Catalog ref is set before initial validation; stable registered targets can resolve.
Serialized semantic value dependency protects raw invalid arrays from unrelated structured-clone changes. This source finding was fixed; actual browser boundary testing is not included in this audit.

limitations: No actual React/browser UI was controlled or visually inspected during this feedback audit. Root owns browser regression and all final build/full-suite evidence.
Transport tests use mocked fetch and Response.json; these tests do not prove actual server HTTP diagnostics behavior.

Deferred response test only proves an obsolete missing node identity cannot resolve against a similarly labelled replacement graph; actual component stale-response guards are source observations, not this test.
Hand-authored parser metadata coverage does not validate every real module catalog constraint or all supported model operations.
View fit tests verify geometry containment and no mutation. They do not certify publication typography, arrow aesthetics, rendering performance, or human novice usability.
AI proxy findings cannot fill the real researcher/publication-human M4 acceptance seats.
